{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ebon Fleet''' was a battle group of more than sixty [[Airship/Legends|airships]] used by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] to fly from their home continent of [[Keshtah Minor|Keshtah]] and [[Invasion of Alanciar|invade]] [[Alanciar]], the continent to their east, in [[2975 BBY]]. Each ship in the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was held aloft by giant [[Atmosphere/Legends|gasbags]] filled with [[Hydrogen/Legends|hydrogen]], while propulsion was provided by flying beasts known as [[uvak]]s that were tethered to each vessel. The fleet was the brainchild of [[Varner Hilts]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Grand Lord]] of the Lost Tribe of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], after he discovered a map that showed the existence of Alanciar on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], where his ancestors had crash-landed centuries before. The ships were designed by another Sith, [[Edell Vrai]], and the fleet was under the command of [[Korsin Bentado]]. When the fleet reached Alanciar, its [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] natives, the [[Alanciari]], downed the vessels by piercing the gasbags with [[Fire/Legends|flaming]] [[Lance/Legends|lances]]. ''[[Yaru]]'' was the leading ship in the Ebon Fleet, captained by Korsin Bentado himself. ''[[Good Omen]]'' was one of the ships in the Ebon Fleet, which carried Grand Lord Varner Hilts.<ref name="Pandemonium">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pandemonium]]''</ref>
